landmarks.name: Virunga National Park
landmarks.writeup: Africa's oldest national park, known for its biodiversity and endangered mountain gorillas.

landmarks.name: Mount Nyiragongo
landmarks.writeup: An active volcano famous for its large lava lake and frequent eruptions.

landmarks.name: Congo River
landmarks.writeup: The second-longest river in Africa, vital for transportation and hydroelectric power.

landmarks.name: Kinshasa Central Market
landmarks.writeup: A bustling market showcasing local crafts, food, and culture.

landmarks.name: National Museum of Kinshasa
landmarks.writeup: Houses important artifacts and exhibits on Congolese history and culture.

cultural_events.name: FESPAM (Pan-African Music Festival)
cultural_events.writeup: A major music festival celebrating African music and culture held in Brazzaville, often involving artists from the DRC.

cultural_events.name: Kinshasa Jazz Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An event promoting jazz music and local musicians in the capital city.

cultural_events.name: National Independence Day
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated on June 30th, marking independence from Belgium in 1960 with parades and cultural performances.

food_writeup: Congolese cuisine features staples like cassava, plantains, rice, and fish, often prepared with rich sauces and spices. Popular dishes include Moambe chicken and Pondu (cassava leaves stew).
brief_history: The DRC was colonized by Belgium in the late 19th century, gaining independence in 1960. It has experienced political instability, civil wars, and conflicts over natural resources but remains rich in minerals and cultural diversity.

important_people.name: Patrice Lumumba
important_people.description: First Prime Minister and independence leader

important_people.name: Simon Kimbangu
important_people.description: Religious leader and founder of Kimbanguism

current_conflicts: Ongoing armed conflicts in the eastern regions involving various rebel groups, ethnic militias, and government forces, often linked to control over mineral resources.
